in_hebrew.name: Aleris
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Other alert, watchful, or noble
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Aleris הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek element 'aleros' meaning 'other' or 'different'. In mythology, Aleris was a name for the goddess Hera in the form of a watchful or protective deity. This name carries the essence of being otherworldly and alert, as well as having a noble and watchful nature.
